properties.name: Near-match refusals 15 and 16, both 2026-09-12, both cross-type, both judged distinct — the count is now 16 of 16
properties.statement: Two more search-first refusals on 2026-09-12, recorded the moment they happened because Anthony was watching the tool tally ("7 tools used (1 failed)") and asked that a mid-task failure not be lost to the task. Both were `add_decision` writing a brainstormed idea: (15) refused against a Decision and a DesignRule — the prior lessons-learned idea and his rule that project rules live in the graph; (16) not refused (distinct_from was given) but the guard named a third near-match, the existing refusal-ledger idea, which turned out to be the new idea's own option A. Both judged distinct; the first re-sent with `distinct_from`, the second linked DEPENDS_ON. Cross-type pairings again (Decision ↔ DesignRule, Decision ↔ Decision of the same kind), so the running count since the 2026-08-31 measurement is 16 refusals / 16 distinct / 0 duplicates. What the guard is actually doing well: it found the earlier idea the agent had not searched for, and the link is the better outcome than the write going through clean.
